title: Each store only sees its own rows
evidence: acme sees 10 products, globex 8, no overlap: True

title: Reading another store's row by id
evidence: HTTP 404

title: Create a child under ANOTHER store's parent (variant -> foreign product)
evidence: HTTP 201: {"id": "962f8003-4a99-43cc-93d1-255437e75f9b", "title": "probe injected", "sku": null, "barcode": null, "price": "1.000000", "compare_at_price": null, "cost": n

title: The foreign parent id is now stored on this store's row
evidence: HTTP 200; product_id=3b750d99-bce7-465e-905b-b3a38fbf0d5e

title: Order line pointing at another store's variant
evidence: HTTP 201

title: Many-to-many link to another store's product
evidence: HTTP 200

title: Re-parent an existing row under another store's parent
evidence: HTTP 200

title: tenant_id / created_by_id in a request body
evidence: HTTP 201: extra fields ignored

title: SKU uniqueness spans ALL stores
evidence: a third store creating sku GLOBEX-HEADPHONES-1 (a globex SKU) -> HTTP 409: it fails, and that also reveals another store uses it

title: Discount codes, order numbers, cart tokens are unique across all stores
evidence: a store reusing globex's code -> HTTP 409. Stores cannot both have order #1001 or code WELCOME10; the seed prefixes everything with a store key

title: Duplicate SKU inside one store is refused
evidence: HTTP 409: {"code": "conflict", "message": "the request conflicts with existing data (duplicate value or referenced record)", "details": []}

title: No public (logged-out) storefront read of tenant data
evidence: GET /products without a token -> HTTP 401. A tenant is resolved from the signed-in user, never from a domain or header

title: Customers cannot sign up to an existing store
evidence: register without an invitation -> HTTP 422 (tenant_required): a sign-up must either create a NEW store or carry an invitation. Only invitations add people to a store

title: A customer cannot read orders
evidence: HTTP 403

title: A customer can read the catalog, drafts and archived included
evidence: HTTP 200; statuses seen ['active', 'archived', 'draft']

title: Customers cannot be shown ONLY their own orders while staff see all
evidence: a row rule applies to every role listed on an operation: 'tenant' for staff would show a customer the whole store, 'owner' would hide orders from staff. Orders are staff-only in this model

title: Customers cannot be shown only active products
evidence: no per-role filter: a custom_filter on status would hide drafts from the staff who need them too

title: Only the store admin can invite
evidence: manager inviting -> HTTP 403

title: No endpoints to list staff, change a role, deactivate or remove a user
evidence: GET /auth/users, /users, /auth/members -> HTTP 404. After inviting someone the store admin cannot demote them or cut their access (only the person can delete their own account)

title: Password reset exists only with email magic link or SMS enabled
evidence: HTTP 404 with magic links off; this model would need magic links on so people can reset passwords

title: Every account also holds the default role
evidence: the support user's roles are ['customer', 'support']: the default role is added to everyone, so it must stay harmless

title: A person cannot belong to two stores with one login (by design, read from the generated model)
evidence: emails are globally unique across tenants, so an agency worker needs one account per store

title: An operation with no permission is open to every signed-in user (documented behaviour)
evidence: the builder does not warn; build_commerce.py audits for this and refuses to build if any enabled operation is unlisted. The first draft of this model had 6 such holes

title: No computed fields or cross-field rules: total is never checked against its parts
evidence: order with subtotal 10 and total 1 -> HTTP 201

title: No state machines or immutable fields
evidence: cancelled->open, changing the order number and placed_at -> HTTP 200. Rules like 'a paid order cannot be edited' need a service in front

title: No stock check, no inventory decrement, no reservation
evidence: order line for 1,000,000 units -> HTTP 201; stock changes are a separate PATCH the client must make (and can race)

title: No atomic increment/decrement and no optimistic locking
evidence: 8 parallel 'take 1' read-modify-writes from stock 1 left available=0 (a correct system ends at 1-8=-7 or refuses): every worker saw stock [1]. A checkout needs UPDATE ... SET available = available - n

title: No CHECK constraints beyond min/max on a field
evidence: available = -50 -> HTTP 200: the field has no minimum, so overselling is representable (declare min_value to prevent it)

title: Money is a fixed NUMERIC(18,6) with no currency, rounding or per-field scale
A number too large for the column
evidence: price 99999999999999 -> HTTP 500: {"code": "internal_error", "message": "An unexpected error occurred", "details": []} (a client error becomes a server error: BUG)

title: HTML fields are stored and returned verbatim
evidence: <script> accepted -> HTTP 201; the storefront must sanitise

title: Secrets stored in an entity are returned by reads
evidence: webhook secret in GET /webhooks: 'whsec_probe_secret' (no write-only fields; any role allowed to read webhooks sees it)

title: Soft deleting a parent does not hide or delete its children
evidence: product soft-deleted; its variant is still returned (HTTP 200)

title: A soft-deleted row still holds its unique values
evidence: a deleted product's variant keeps its SKU reserved; re-using it -> HTTP 409

title: Orders cannot be deleted (operation not enabled)
evidence: HTTP 405

title: A catalog editor cannot delete products
evidence: HTTP 403

title: Composite unique/indexes
evidence: a second inventory level for the same (variant, location) was just accepted; 'one per pair' cannot be declared

title: Deleting a location that stock points to is refused
evidence: HTTP 409: {"code": "conflict", "message": "the request conflicts with existing data (duplicate value or referenced record)", "details": []}

title: Cannot filter by a relation (orders of one customer)
evidence: ?customer_id=... -> HTTP 200; total 12: the filter is ignored. Only declared exact-match fields filter

title: No range, 'in', or date filters (price between, orders since a date)
evidence: ?total__gte=100 -> HTTP 200: ignored

title: One sort field at a time
evidence: ?sort=-placed_at,total -> HTTP 200

title: Page size is capped
evidence: limit=1000 -> HTTP 422: {"code": "validation_error", "message": "Request validation failed", "details": [{"loc": ["query", "limit"], "msg": "Input should be less than or equal to 100",

title: A parent returns child ids, not child rows; no aggregates or reports
evidence: order has 4 line ids and 1 transaction ids: rendering one order page takes 1 + N requests. There is no sum/count/group-by (sales per day, top products)

title: Text search over declared fields
evidence: ?q=Tee -> 2 products (substring match, no ranking or full-text index)

title: Checkout, payments, taxes, shipping quotes, discount validation, email notifications
evidence: the backend stores rows; every rule above is a service the application must add (populate_commerce.py plays that role)

title: File and image upload
evidence: images are URL strings; there is no upload or storage

title: Webhooks, events, background jobs, scheduled work
evidence: the Webhook entity only stores configuration; nothing is ever delivered

title: Idempotency keys for retried requests
evidence: a retried POST /transactions creates a second transaction (only unique fields protect you)

title: Change history
evidence: only created_by_id exists; no updated_by, no history of who changed a price or a status

title: Tenant management
evidence: no endpoint to rename or close a store, to move a user between stores, or for a platform operator to see all stores

title: Bulk import / batch writes
evidence: one row per request: the seed needs ~800 calls; there is no CSV import or batch endpoint

title: Polymorphic relations
evidence: Metafield.owner_type/owner_id is just two columns: no foreign key, no referential integrity

title: Reserved words
evidence: field names such as zip and format, and enum values with '/' or spaces, are refused (renamed in this model)

title: A role inherits from one parent only
evidence: manager cannot inherit from catalog + fulfilment + support; permissions list roles explicitly instead
